name: farmstead-taiga
description: Farmstead, the taiga look (ROADMAP 49.10e): the shipped Farmstead drawn again as a forest croft: a log house gable-on to the road on a mossy fieldstone footing under a broad slate gable, a svalgang along the field under one low eave, and (II) a tall cross barn of logs on a fieldstone byre with a hoist gablet; (III) a root cellar.
